top_insights.text: In a two-proposer design debate, devils-advocate fact-checked every load-bearing claim against ground truth, ruled per disagreement axis instead of both-sides mush, and steelmanned a hybrid that became the shipped design. The stakes-calibration table maps well to mid-development use.

devils-advocate does not distinguish 'disproven' (verified false) from 'unverified' (no evidence either way) attacks; one critique presented absence of precedent as a counterargument. Suggest requiring each attack be labeled with its evidence status, as the new brainstorm skill mandates.
